description: Read a section of a GoVisit destination category page. Use it to understand the category or inspect the place cards the page presents. Returns the selected overview or places section with its source page and freshness.

pagePath.description: Canonical GoVisit page path supplying this tool's published context; no origin, query or fragment.

section.description: Published section of the selected page to read.

name: get_category_section

outputSchema.description: Successful read of the sanitized published page snapshot. Unsupported sections reject the invocation.

items.description: Published section records; fields depend on the section and the page projection.

anyOf.description: Named public fields or an items list, such as places.items, location coordinates, opening hours or experience groups.
anyOf.title: Published structured section

data.description: The requested published section. Overview is an object; lists are arrays of at most 20 items; places/experiences may wrap items in an object; missing opening-hours data is null. Strings and nested lists are bounded by the WebMCP snapshot policy.

items.description: Published JSON value; optional field shapes depend on the page projection.

title: Get category section
